theme_cosine_raw.note: inflated by shared compositional baseline; not a stand-alone preservation measure

theme_null_mean.note: distinctive cosine to OTHER analytes' SERS — the background floor

theme_separation.note: distinct - null; >0 means the SERS theme profile resembles its OWN Raman profile more than a random one

self_theme_rank.note: rank of the correct analyte among all 51 by distinctive theme cosine; chance median ~26

metric_definitions.component_cosine: cosine(z_Raman, z_AgSERS) over the 24 NMF coordinates — LATENT FINGERPRINT PRESERVATION
metric_definitions.theme_cosine: cosine(b_Raman, b_AgSERS) over the 11 biochemical THEME composition shares (RAW; baseline-inflated) — THEME PRESERVATION
metric_definitions.theme_cosine_distinct: cosine of baseline-SUBTRACTED theme vectors (each minus mean Raman composition) — the honest theme-preservation signal
metric_definitions.theme_null_mean: mean distinctive cosine of A's SERS theme profile to every OTHER analyte's — the background floor
metric_definitions.theme_separation: theme_cosine_distinct - theme_null_mean; >0 = SERS resembles its own Raman theme more than a random analyte's
metric_definitions.self_is_nearest_theme: the distinctive SERS theme profile's nearest Raman profile (over all analytes) is the SAME analyte
metric_definitions.mss_cosine: cosine over the 12 biochemical MSS motif activations
metric_definitions.expected_retained_top3: family's expected theme is in the Ag-SERS top-3
metric_definitions.tiers: manually-selected DESCRIPTIVE thresholds (0.80/0.65/0.45/0.25), not learned classes
